# I Love Tools

A free, browser-based toolkit. All tools run client-side in the user's browser - no uploads, no servers, no signup.

## What the site offers
- 40+ utilities across Text, Encoding, Developer, Calculators, SEO, and PDF categories
- Home Easy: construction & home material estimators (India-standard) - brick, concrete, plaster, tiles, paint, steel/TMT, plumbing, room finish
- FunZone: free browser games (Tic-Tac-Toe, Snake, Memory Match, Rock Paper Scissors, Number Guess)

## Key pages
- Home: https://ilovetools.pro/
- QR Code Generator: https://ilovetools.pro/tools/qr-generator.html
- PDF Tools: https://ilovetools.pro/#pdf
- Construction Estimators: https://ilovetools.pro/tools/brick-estimate.html
- FunZone Games: https://ilovetools.pro/funzone.html
- Privacy Policy: https://ilovetools.pro/pages/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://ilovetools.pro/pages/terms.html

## Notes for agents
- Content is static HTML; tools are interactive client-side JavaScript.
- No login or backend APIs are required to use any tool.
